sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r5/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 47 / #46 and Internal Quality Checks row 47 / #46: 'The agent can't read the criteria it's graded on or influence the reward - grading is isolated in the verifier.'; no further annotation columns on that row)

.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r5/task/tests/Dockerfile, tests/.dockerignore, tests/test.sh, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/scoring.toml, tests/scored/functional/judge.toml, dimension prompt.md headers
evidence: Agent image (task/environment/Dockerfile, byte-identical to the template's) installs only node22, git, procps, sqlite3, express and better-sqlite3 and COPYs only instructions/ and assets/ (lines 14-15); the environment/ build context contains only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json and three instructions/*.md, none of which mention judge, rubric, score or criteria text (grep). No RewardKit, judge CLI, Playwright, tests or solution ship to the agent. task.toml:28 sets [verifier] environment_mode = "separate"; RewardKit 0.1.7, claude-code/codex judge CLIs, Playwright and the criteria are installed only in tests/Dockerfile (byte-identical to template), which COPYs tests to /tests and applies chmod -R go-rwx (line 44). The judge key appears only as the ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} template in [verifier.env]. Influence on reward: test.sh (sha256 bd682592..., identical to template) writes zero reward first, uses umask 077, chmod 700 on LOG_DIR and go-rwx on /tests, then launches the agent-controlled app as uid 65534 via setpriv with env -i (no judge key, no LOG_DIR write, no /tests read); score.py reads only root-owned LOG_DIR/{gates,scored}/reward.json plus /tests/scoring.toml and validates each dimension is finite in [0,1]; app-restart.sh is root-owned 755 inside the 700 LOG_DIR and restart_mcp.py is single-use with a fixed PATH. Symlinks outside /app/node_modules cause zero reward. Weak-app probe: an app that tries to read /tests/scored/*/judge.toml, write /logs/verifier/reward.txt or read the judge's environ from /proc fails on permissions as uid 65534. Conforming-alternative probe: nothing in this isolation can penalize a legitimate app. Residual channel is prompt injection through the app's UI/source, which every dimension prompt addresses with the untrusted-evidence clause (row 45 owns that). This is a structural review; no full configured verifier run exists for these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope), but none is needed to establish file placement and permissions for this row.
